reason: Pediatrix sells physician-staffed neonatal, maternal-fetal and pediatric care. It contracts with hospitals and bills payers. Chemed is a hospice operator (VITAS) combined with a plumbing and drain-cleaning business (Roto-Rooter, including franchises). Hospice for terminally ill patients is not the same service or patient population as neonatal and pediatric care, and half of Chemed is unrelated home services. The only shared trait is Medicare/Medicaid-style healthcare reimbursement.
